policies.title: About this demo
policies.content: This is an independent portfolio demonstration, not an official commercial shop. All products, rates, policies and visits are illustrative. Razorpay is in test mode; no real money is charged. Jewellery photographs are AI-generated.

policies.title: Pricing and quotes
policies.content: Demo metal value is net metal weight multiplied by the owner-confirmed daily rate for its purity. Each piece then uses either its configured percentage of metal value or its fixed making charge; a fixed charge overrides the percentage. Stone charges are added, followed by the illustrative 3% tax on the subtotal. Product pages and quote breakdowns show the exact charges. Quotes remain valid for 15 minutes and cannot be edited. A fresh quote requires customer confirmation. These are fictional demo rules, not investment advice.

policies.title: Privacy and support
policies.content: Use a demo identity and do not submit personal or financial information in chat or product photos. Customers can access only their own orders and conversations. Ask for a human to flag a conversation for owner review.

policies.title: Reservations
policies.content: One piece priced above ₹25,000 can be reserved with a ₹1,000 test token. A confirmed token payment holds it for 48 hours and freezes the quoted demo price. Choose a visit within 48 hours. The token is credited against the in-store balance. Cancellation or expiry sends a token refund request to the owner.

policies.title: Returns and refunds
policies.content: For this demo you may request a refund for a purchase or selected order items. Every request requires owner approval. A request is not a promise of eligibility or completed payment. Provider-confirmed refunds update your order. Items are not automatically restocked.

policies.title: Visits and fulfilment
policies.content: Store visits and fulfilment are simulated. Choose a reservation time and present the reservation code in the owner panel. Online orders can be marked ready or completed by staff. There is no real carrier or store appointment behind this demo.
